purpose: Separate primary activity from TDI shift among selected hits; test whether correction for primary-conditioned label availability changes historical concordance.
limits: Fit availability propensity on outer-training measured primary response and missingness only. Missing class labels are selection outcomes, never TDI-negative outcomes. MAR and positivity are unverified; clipping does not fill absent weak-activity labels. Primary response is used for evaluation weighting, not a deployable hidden assay feature.
